column3: Translate: lookup 0x00689130 read and fixed (empty->"", all-digit key->itself, exact then tolower-folded, text and justtext both names with the later row winning 0x00689f40, empty result->key); gaps: the running script's file name as context (0x006a3a60) not passed (no shipped key carries one), map table (0xa77e90) merged into the pack's rather than asked second (differs only where the pack answers a name with itself)

Translatef(key,a1): formatter 0x006897a0 read and fixed (each %s argument translated 0x00689a82, %% -> %, multi-digit N, bad placeholder -> "Bad parameter at pos P", finished text that is a name translated again 0x00689650); gaps: %d prints a pointer in the original (argument text written instead), N past the arguments left as written, same merged map table as Translate
Translatef(key,a1,a2): as 0x004c9ea0
Translatef(key,a1,a2,a3): as 0x004c9ea0; this arity was not registered and now is
pr(str): "%s" to the debug console (0x00619060), no check, no state
pr(int): "%d" to the debug console
pr(bool): prints true/false; a VS bool reaches the host as an integer here, so it prints 1/0 (debug output only)

Obj::pr(str): prints only when [obj+0x74] equals the debug era 0x00821354 (Obj::GetDebug's test); invalid receiver logs and answers nothing; not registered: every shipped site is commented out and the per-object debug flag is unmodelled
Obj::pr(int): as 0x005abb20 with "%d"
Obj::pr(handle): as 0x005abb20, printing "(h:%d,o:%d)"

Breakpoint and the other names on this body: answers 0, touches nothing; for GetGAIKA(int) and GAIKA::ID the untouched VM stack makes the argument the answer (sim/ai.cpp, sim/squad.cpp identity functions)
ParseStr: skips leading spaces only (0x20), token to the first comma with trailing spaces cut, tail after the comma verbatim (fixed: tabs were trimmed and the tail was trimmed)
Str2Int: CRT atol 0x00763919 -- isspace skip, one sign, digits with 32-bit wrap (fixed: no white-space skip, saturated)
StrLen: bytes before NUL (0x00649b40); null string 0
ClearDebug: adds one to the debug era 0x00821354 and nothing else (fixed: it cleared the debug console, which is cls's); the era and per-object flag ([obj+0x74], Obj::GetDebug) are unmodelled
StrMid: len capped at strlen-start when that is not more, floored at 0; negative start reads before the string in the original, answered as start 0

Obj::range: [obj+0xd4], invalid -> 0; fixed (round 11): the stored range the rebuild 0x005d9df0 writes, the stand_position formation's BonusRange percent included (0x005da4d6), which Unit::InRange's far edge (0x005a7800) and GotoAttack's arrival now read too; a non-combatant answers its class range (was 0)

Obj::attack/damage: [obj+0xdc], invalid -> 0; fixed (round 11): the stored attack the rebuild writes -- class, AddBonus record, items (each kind once, percents of the class value), Epic Attack, formation BonusDamage, Team Attack, Frenzy x2 (0x005da6fc) -- read by the blow and the census as well

IsValidTarget: the receiver's CanAttack virtual only (invalid target false silently, invalid receiver logs); fixed: target_factor -1 no longer refused; gap: engine's strict is_enemy vs the virtual's wider rule

BestTargetInSquadSight/0: invalid/dead receiver -> invalid; held -> invalid (fixed); a squad member takes the squad path, whose deque squad+0x6c..0x7c nothing pushes, and gets the invalid handle -- NOT applied: measured on Alesia it leaves armies standing out of reach (1904 vs 325), because what engages a squad member in the original is not modelled (design gap); free unit -> circle on hero/self at [+0xd0]; gap (design): score factor+40*threat+surface d with in-range <50 stop/-100, units only + catapult fallback, threat counters, grid order -- engine scores d^2*factor/priority
BestTargetInSquadSight/1(str): as /0 (held guard fixed, squad-member gap as /0); class mismatch +200 (0x005db789) taken to its limit on the engine score scale

Obj::Damage: answers is-dead, true for invalid receiver, n<0 logs and false (fixed: was void and a script error); clamp, store, death 0x005b16f0 -- now also on script objects such as Mist and CoverOfMercy (fixed); gap: ambient-civilian immunity [obj+0x2c]&0x4000000 not modelled
Query::Damage: no refresh, skips dead, no sign check, answers the kill count; engine has no Query form (Damage/1 on a group does nothing); no shipped site damages a group

Building::Attack: fire rate isqrt(military+min(other,10))*BaseFireRate/100 (0x005c2fb0), 0 -> false; per-building attack_delay and per-settlement cadence waits; fires once and answers true; gap (design): tower fire is script-driven per call in the original, CombatSystem::act acquisition here, with no garrison gate

Catapult::Attack(point): sets the shot point, activity 2, waits for the shot; gap (design): catapult fire is CATAPULT_AUTOFIRE-driven in the original and acquisition-driven here; the point overload reads pt.x as an object id
Obj::SetStamina: raw store through vtbl+0x9c, no clamp, no dead check, invalid receiver no-op; fixed for objects the combat system does not hold

Unit::Attack: target stored before the gate, gate = CanAttack virtual + range 0x005a7800, refused -> false without suspending, accepted -> suspends until the swing ends; gaps: range half not modelled (shared reach measure with GotoAttack), suspension is attack_interval, refused path does not store the target

Obj::Heal: n<0 changes nothing (fixed), min(h+n,max) through the health store, cure at full health (fixed), script objects (fixed); gap: the original writes a dying unit's health, the engine's heal refuses it
Query::Heal: refresh, skip dead, min(h+n,max), no sign check; engine has no Query form for Heal; no shipped site heals a group
Catapult::InRange(point): isqrt(d2)-own radius in [min_range, range], no min<1 escape; gap (design, with Catapult::Attack): the point overload is not dispatched and reads pt.x as an object id

Unit::InRange: held receiver -> false (fixed); surface band isqrt(d2)-r1-r2 in [min,range], min<1 skips the inner bound; gap: engine measures min centre to centre and max squared, kept shared with GotoAttack's arrival (Balcans EPRIEST_IDLE spin)

Obj::maxstamina: [obj+0xcc], invalid -> 0; a combatant answers its stored maximum (round 11: the rebuild's class + record + item stamina term); gap: non-combatants answer 0 here (a HeroGrave's holds the dead hero's level, and graves are not spawned)
Unit::maxstamina: the class record's value (+0x298), no bonus; one engine member serves both forms and answers the stored [obj+0xcc], which adds the AddBonus term every shipped AddBonus passes as 0
Obj::HealStamina: n<0 refused, min(s+n,maxstamina), no dead check; fixed for script objects
Query::HealStamina: refreshed members, dead skipped, no sign check (fixed: dead members were healed and negatives refused)
BestTargetForPos: no squad gate, held -> invalid, surface d in [min,range]; gaps: the score design of /0, min measured centre to centre, buildings offered
CanAttack: dead target then dead receiver -> false (fixed), CanAttack virtual, then range; gap: range half omitted so it refuses exactly what Attack refuses (RAM_ATTACK loop)

Catapult::SetTarget: stores the handle at +0x228 unvalidated and mirrors it to the settlement's CatapultTowers' ui_target; gap (design, with Catapult::Attack): engine order_attack engages instead and mirrors nothing
InvalidateDamageFormulaParams: zeroes the reload flag 0x00996ae8; the engine caches nothing, so nothing to invalidate
BestTargetInRange: ForPos's core centred on the point, r<1 -> [+0xd0], x==-1 -> own position (not reproduced); gaps as ForPos

BestTargetInSquadSightMisZeroDamage: the circle path shifts its flag into the exclusive slot (0x005dca31), so the answer is /0 (fixed: the engine filtered unarmed targets); held guard fixed; squad-member and score gaps as /0
Catapult::ClearTarget: clears +0x228 and the settlement CatapultTowers' ui_target; gap (design): engine stop() idles the catapult and leaves the towers

Building::BestTarget: box +-sight, units only, not hidden, first in [min,range] stops, else threat<=3 nearest; registered BestTarget/0 answers with the unit core here -- a separate handler belongs with the scripted tower-fire design

Catapult::BestTarget: buildings first by max target_priority in [min,range], not Wall, nearly-destroyed spared unless a garrisoned centre; units only while [+0x22c]; answered with the unit core here, with the catapult-fire design
Catapult::GetPointOnTarget: receiver checked first, (0,0) on either failure (fixed), unit target -> posRH (fixed); gap: the footprint walk for a building is not modelled (no per-object cell list)

BestTargetInSquadSightExclusive: on the circle path its flag lands in the independents slot -- wildlife excluded, mismatch +200 not rejected, unknown name -> unfiltered minus wildlife (fixed); held guard fixed; squad-member and score gaps as /0

BestTargetInSquadSight_PreferUndiseased: diseased candidate +200 on both paths; held guard fixed; gaps: Disease now sets a flag and the alias does not add the penalty; squad-member and score gaps as /0
TimeWithoutAttack: now - [unit+0x1a4], invalid -> 0

EnemiesInSight: invalid/dead/held -> false, circle [+0xd0] rim inclusive, enemy unit not dead with damage > 1 and the looker's CanAttack (fixed); gap: a hidden unit counts when the looker's player sees it, approximated as never
Obj::SetHealth: raw store, no death at 0; the unit store cures disease on reaching max (fixed); script objects (fixed)
SetExperienceModifier: player-1 signed <16, [record+0x84]; <=0 is an out-of-bounds write in the original, unreachable from shipped data
Unit::AddBonus: args 1-4, argument 4 into both max slots, argument 5 unread, then the rebuild (round 11: now the real rebuild, health and stamina rescaled by new/old maximum, sim/stats.cpp)
BestNoIndependentTargetInSquadSight: its flag is dropped on the circle path, so the answer is /0 (fixed: engine excluded wildlife); held guard fixed; squad-member and score gaps as /0

Unit::RecalcBonuses: vtbl+0xc4 -- the rebuild 0x005d9df0 on a unit, a bare ret on a building; fixed (round 11): stored stats and level rebuilt in full (class, record, items once per kind, Toughness, Statue of Amon-Ra, Epic/Team skills, formation, Defensive Cry, Battle Cry, Frenzy, addend, Discipline, rescale) at the original's triggers (docs/formats/unit-stats.md); gaps: a timed skill's expiry rebuild runs at the turn's end, not on its millisecond, and the hero tick behind the addend is anchored on world-clock multiples of 1013 ms (inferred), not on the hero's creation

rollover(): title (yellow translated rollover, hotkey form) + newline + translated description as the command loader 0x004f2240 composes them; engine joins the raw keys; tooltip text no script compares

rollover(obj,bool): title, newline + cost line (gold/food/stamina-or-Loyality/pop icons, red when unaffordable by obj), description, then bool: red Not-enough lines; engine: raw keys and a plain cost line after the description
rollover(obj,class,bool): the (obj,bool) form plus a class Stats/Specials line before the description; costs are the described command's; engine looks the class up as a command row
rollover(obj,str): title + newline + translated str + description, obj unread; engine puts the message after the description, untranslated
rollover_desc: title + newline + translated msg + (bool ? description : ""), no costs; engine treats bool as show-costs
CreateFeedback(unit,class): effect object in an unsynced handle slot (0x0067b480), no answer; invalid unit or unknown class logs only
CreateFeedback(unit,class,ms): as the 2-argument form with an expiry; unbound, no site
CreateFeedback(point,class): effect at a point, unsynced slot, no answer
CreateFeedback(point,class,ms): as the point form with an expiry; unbound, no site
View: camera move and lock flag 0x00996ff8=bLock only for a point inside the map rect, inclusive (fixed: was unconditional)
ShowHint: 0 without a hint manager, never suspends; result discarded at every site
PlayMovie: synchronous with the game paused, answers whether it played, always ends with input unblocked 0x004c7f35 (fixed); engine plays nothing and answers false

SetShortcutSel: p-1 in 0..15 and num in 0..9 else nothing, non-empty list ORs 1</SelectionAssigned (fixed); gap: the group is copied as given, not refilled through the selection-add rules (0x005b9170)
SetFog: queued command to the display flag; the engine applies it at once, which no script can tell apart
BlockUserInput: interface block 0x005e31e0(1,1), hints closed; no answer
UnblockUserInput: 0x005e31e0(0,1); no answer
UserNotification: panel only when player-1 is the local player; no answer
ShowAnnouncement(key,value): ticker table 0x00996890[0]; no getter
ShowAnnouncement(player,...): per-player table 1..16; unbound, no shipped site
Obj::PlaySound: invalid handle logs; positional play when on screen and visible to the local player
PlaySound(name): global play; the variant draw is the C runtime's rand (0x006b0da0), not the simulation's
PlaySound(player,name): plays only when player-1 is the local player
HideZoomMap: the panel's hide virtual only; hiding does not stamp the shown time
ShowTutorial: ShowHint with the tutorial icon and the 0x005bde80 gate; result discarded
ViewPos: the screen centre converted to world (x snapped to 4, terrain height); engine returns the stored View point exactly, which the save-and-restore idiom cannot tell apart
HideAnnouncement(key): hides the entry in table 0
HideAnnouncement(player,key): per-player table 1..16; unbound, no shipped site
cls: blanks every line of the console pr writes to and zeroes the count (0x00618a10 on [0x00996ff4]+0x44cc) (fixed: was a no-op)
LockView: 0x00996ff8 = 1
UnlockView: 0x00996ff8 = 0

_ZoomMapLastShownTime: settings key /Player<local+1>/ZoomMapShown minus 1 (no map prefix, -1 in multiplayer), written now+1 by the panel; engine keeps a per-session stamp and answers -1 with no interface

Catapult::GetCurrentTarget: pushes the handle at [cat+0x228] (0xffff -> null), invalid receiver logs and answers null; engine answers Combatant::target, which SetTarget sets only when order_attack accepts (design, with Catapult::SetTarget)
